audit_items.proof_trace: The dashboard layout queries `member.members` by `supabase_auth_user_id` without `.is('deleted_at', null)` (L102-108), so a soft-deleted member's row is still returned and they pass the only profile gate, gaining full dashboard access. Additionally, `getTeamStats` (actions.ts:772-777) and `getMonthlyTeamAttendanceStats` (actions.ts:820-825) filter only on `status != 2` and omit `deleted_at IS NULL`, so soft-deleted members with status 0 or 1 are counted in active team member totals and attendance rate denominators.
audit_items.attack_scenario: A member whose `deleted_at` is set by an admin retains a valid Discord OAuth session cookie; they navigate to `/dashboard`, pass the middleware cookie check, receive their profile row (no `deleted_at` filter), pass the Discord server membership check (if still in server), and gain full attendance-system access including recording attendance and viewing team data.
